notes.itemTitle: Close the KITAS and withdraw BPJS
notes.title: No renewal left to buy
notes.text: Chitra at InCorp wrote overnight that a renewal is no longer possible, because it had to start a month before the 8 November expiry. Staying past that date risks an overstay charge of IDR 1 million a day, and consequences for Locus as your sponsor. - So the cancellation and the exit permit before you fly are the whole of it now.

notes.itemTitle: Apply: Google Business Analyst MBA intern, Dublin
notes.title: Google closes while you travel
notes.text: Today is the start-by for both Google applications, Dublin and London, and they close on the 8th while you are moving countries. The Amazon one is in, so the CV is ready to reuse. - Worth doing both today while you are still at a desk.
